newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Siu-Fung shrs dive to touch all time low.
newsitem.headline: Siu-Fung shrs dive to touch all time low.

text.p: Shares of Siu-Fung Ceramics Holdings Ltd continued to fall and touched their all-time low of HK$0.58 on Wednesday morning on dilution fear due to the company's rights issue plan and pessmistic earnings prospects after the closure of its German plant, brokers said.
Siu-Fung stood at HK$0.59 at midday, down HK$0.04 or 6.35 percent from the previous close. Volume was 21.83 million shares worth HK$13.08 million.
The shares have fallen some 68 percent since their year closing high of HK$1.79 made on June 10.
